text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out with Durandal, as we passed through a shopping street,
her steps came to a halt in front of a local Chinese restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, um,
it's my usual spot, but... I saw a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san?
Did you start a part-time job or something?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I am merely assisting with the shop's repairs.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, little ladies.
Sorry, but as you can see, we're closed today.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I can tell it's your day off, but...
Why are you doing repair work, Believe-san?"

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty worn down, but it's a shop full of memories.
I asked for repairs to see if it could hold out a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Repairman
text_block_list.text:
Man... I threw my back out for the first time in a while.
Sorry 'bout that.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: So, while I was wondering what to do, young miss Believe offered to help out.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
This is a shop that has long been loved by this town.
I believe places like this should be preserved.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I agree. And if it means preserving a beloved shop for everyone,
it is my duty to lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—...Guh,
how utterly pathetic of me...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Helping those who should be helped" must be the right thing to do. And yet... to think there's nothing I can do to help...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Everything Believe-san is doing right now involves adjusting and machining parts to the millimeter.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is very delicate work...
and at the same time, something I am quite unsuited for.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to help if I can...
However, the only thing I can offer right now is manual labor—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'll manage somehow.
After all, it is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: That might be true, but screwing in bolts while holding down this oversized sign... No matter how tough you are, little lady, doing it alone is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Is this my turn to shine?!
...I'm on my way!
choice_data_list: Now go and work to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: All I have to do is support it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
No, well... I suppose so.
If you could hold it until I tack it in place.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me!
I'll give you my full and solid support!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...You look happy.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I vowed to the Lord that I would be one to extend a helping hand.
As long as I can fulfill that, the size of the task does not matter.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And by consistently doing what is right,
I can maintain a heart that I can be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Besides, I wanted to return the favor just as much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: High-precision work is my job, after all... But if it's auxiliary tasks like hauling materials or tearing down scrap, even someone who isn't great at delicate work could probably help.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I feel like I can really contribute to something like that!
I'm itching to get started!
choice_data_list: Let's start with hauling materials, then.
Let's help out by clearing scrap wood and doing demolition.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hup!
That makes half!
choice_data_list: Be careful not to drop it~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Nothing has been overlooked! Behold my prowess as a match for a thousand warriors!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Work is all done.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
You girls were a real lifesaver!
Thanks to you, I can keep the shop running!

text_block_list.name: Landlady
text_block_list.text:
Please let me treat you today.
Make sure to eat plenty.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful for your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san was... a big help too.
It would have taken a bit more time if I were alone.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Shopkeeper, if there's ever another chance to help with repairs,
please don't hesitate to call on me again!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a wonderful mood, Durandal happily
stuffed her cheeks with the thank-you meal...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I have finished dismantling the cleared materials.
The sharpness of my hand blade does not shame the name of the holy sword, either.
choice_data_list: Dismantling it with your bare hands... You never cease to amaze me...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Now, let us move on to the next!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Man... you two really finished it all by yourselves.
You young ladies are seriously something else!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Securing pathways while observing the surroundings.
Handling materials without wasting a second.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I think that was a job well done,
Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Repairman
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome anytime if you ever feel like learning the ropes.
...Though you folks definitely look happiest when you're running.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Indeed. But if there is ever another chance
to be of assistance, I would be delighted to help.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Because nothing brings me greater joy
than being someone who can help others."
